# QUASAR — dsh-quasar-theme
English | 中文

**QUASAR** is a space-themed skin for **DeepSeek Harness**: an ink black hole in
the sidebar brand r

ow, a live accretion disk behind the app, and one removable
override layer of 53 measured tokens who

se translucent surfaces are solved
against a contrast budget rather than picked by eye.

The name is the one the interface carries — the sidebar reads `QUASAR CORE` — and
the package follow

s it: `dsh-quasar-theme`. A quasar is a black hole with an
accretion disk and a jet, which is what t
he canvas layer draws.

**This repository ships no background picture.** The paint layer is here, the
artwork is not — the t

racked wallpaper manifest is empty, so a fresh clone draws
the documented no-art state and makes no
third-party request.

Both captures are the current build, dark and light, at 1600×1000. The
conversation list is hidden i
n both; nothing else is edited.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with a web profile.
- Node.js >= 18 — only for the build and check tools. The the

me itself runs in
the browser.
## Install
From npm — a versioned tarball with the browser bundle already built in:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Straight from the public repository, which tracks its default branch:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The package carries a `prepare` script that runs exactly that build, so an
install straight from the

Git URL produces the bundle before the package is
linked; the npm tarball ships `client.js` ready-m

ade and runs no build. From a
local checkout or a clone of it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Run the build once after cloning: `client.js` is generated and deliberately not
tracked (see Layout)

. A plain `git clone` needs one build — `npm run
build`, or any `npm install` inside the checkout, w
hich triggers `prepare`.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the profile reconciles its bundle
stack against the inst

alled package and mounts the theme. If it does not appear
after a restart, append `dsh-quasar-theme`

to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the
profile's `package.json` — a package that is merely a dependency is

ile.bundles` in the
profile's `package.json` — a package that is merely a dependency is not mounted.
## Remove
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Drop the entry from `dsh.profile.bundles` too if you added it there.
## What it is

| Modes | Light and dark, one override layer each arm |
| Token layer | 53 measured overrides — 41 i

n the light arm, 12 in the dark arm |
| Translucent surfaces | Two tokens carry a veil alpha: 0.84 i

n light, 0.35 in dark. Input cards and menus sit at 0.30 |
| Wallpaper | **None.** The paint layer a

nd its no-art state are here; no artwork ships, is hotlinked, or is fetched at paint time |
| Black
hole | A canvas layer behind the app: a photon ring and shadow, a lensed accretion disk whose 24 pat
ches have finite lifetimes and are sheared by their own differential orbit. Phenomenological, not an

MHD solve |
| Brand mark | The ink black hole supplied for this theme, drawn at 28×28 inside the si

debar's 36×36 slot |
| Wordmark | `QUASAR` in Cinzel 700 (0.10em tracking) and a `CORE` chip in EB G

aramond 500 / 12px, both embedded as data URLs |
| Composer row | The merged model control becomes t
wo independent buttons — model and reasoning effort — each with its own popover, neither with a disc

losure chevron |
| Also inside | A pin button on every workspace and session row; a session status r

ail; the four popovers that hang off the composer row centred on their triggers |
| Language | All u
ser-facing text goes through the official locale service (zh / en) |

The theme installs one layer and can be removed as one. It ships **no settings
panel of its own** —

the look is fixed, not a preference — and the only thing it
persists is the workspace pin set and th

e composer's collapsed-popover state,
under `quasar-theme/workspace-pins` and `quasar-theme/model-gr

oups-collapsed`.
It does hide and move a few official entries, so read
What it changes in the interf

ace before you
install it.
## What it changes in the interface

Removing the package takes the layer away again and every official element comes
back. In between, t

he theme **hides seven official entries, rewrites the sidebar
identity line, removes the new-session

page's title row, and reshapes the
composer's control row**. All of it is CSS plus a few client eff

ects — the
official DOM is never rewritten.
### The brand row is three click zones

The sidebar brand row reads **[ink black hole] QUASAR CORE**; the official
wordmark and its whale gl

yph are hidden. It is one official button carrying three
zones, decided from the click's x coordinat

It is one official button carrying three
zones, decided from the click's x coordinate at click time:
| Click | Opens | Because |
| the ink mark, left of `QUASAR` | the **plugin panel** | the nav's 「插件」 row is hidden, so this is i

ts only door |
| the `QUASAR` text | a **new session** | official behaviour, unchanged |
[该节后续省略]
### What the theme adds

- A **pin button** on every workspace and session row (置顶工作区 / Pin workspace,
following the host's l

anguage). The pinned set lives in browser storage under
`quasar-theme/workspace-pins`; the order it

produces is written through the host's
own insert-before API, so it survives a restart — and, unlike

the pin set, it
also survives removing the theme.
- The **session status rail**: blue and breathing

while a session waits for you
(an approval, a question, a plan review), red while it is the one ope

n in the
main area, purple while it finished unread. A pinned row gets a rainbow title
instead of a

rail.
- The **accretion disk** behind the app: a black hole with a lensed disk, drawn on
a canvas an

d shaded per cell. Patches are advected by their own orbit, so a patch
is sheared into an arc instea

d of sliding as a block. It holds still for anyone
who asked for reduced motion.
- A **continuous co

mposer transition**: sending the first message of a session
slides the composer card down as one mov

e instead of fading it out and popping
a new one in.

Settings themselves remain the official dialog. The single change there is that
the dim tint behind

it is removed; the panel and click-outside-to-close are
untouched.
